Picture
- Made entirely in code (Canvas2D): engine.js, film.js. No generated images, no photos, no third-party artwork.

def busbell(v):
    d = 1.2; tt = t_(d)
    x = sum(a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * tt) * env_exp(d, tau) for f, a, tau in [(1760, 1, .4), (3520, .35, .2), (2637, .3, .3), (5280, .12, .08)])
